svg.title: V09 · Albums · paired light and dark synthetic design
svg.desc: Cover, hidden status, keyboard and create actions. Two 1080 by 2340 synthetic S24+ design frames; not runtime screenshots. Content has distinct spatial controls and alternate state panels. Assumed 72px status/navigation insets, V09 488px keyboard. Touchable implementation minimum 48dp; actual dp and rendered font must be checked.
